text:
alex: Heads-up: canary for session-service is flapping with ImagePullBackOff right after node rotation. Canary is 5/40 replicas.

ci-bot: [ci] image promotion completed: session-service:v2026-04-02 -> registry.redwood/prod/session-service:v2026-04-02

rachel: I see `ErrImagePull` in logs. Registry reported 429 quota on one regional mirror during the rotation window.

alex: exact `kubectl describe pod` snippet: 
```
Events:
  Type    Reason     Age   From               Message
  ----    ------     ----  ----               -------
  Warning Failed     1m    kubelet, ip-10-0  Failed to pull image "registry.redwood/prod/session-service:v2026-04-02": rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = quota exceeded (429)
  Normal  BackOff    30s   kubelet, ip-10-0  Back-off pulling image "registry.redwood/prod/session-service:v2026-04-02"
```

deploy-bot: [auto] Canary health degraded: readiness < 70% for 3m. Promotion pipeline paused. See /deploys/1769509999.

liam: Is this the new multi-mirror rollout we enabled? Mirrors should failover, but quota means some nodes can't pull.

nora: Two options: (A) pin the canary to previous image digest that is already cached on nodes (fast rollback), (B) re-run registry promotion to an alternate mirror (slow), (C) temporarily increase image pull concurrency/quota (ops intervention).

alex: ops is slow right now. I lean to pinning - cheaper and quick. We can patch the canary `values.yaml` to reference `image.digest: sha256:abcdef...` from last stable. That avoids registry API pressure.

rachel: agreed. We'll do a pinned digest canary, observe 10m, then re-promote the new digest once mirrors recover. Add a blurb to release notes: "Temporarily pinned session-service image for canary to mitigate mirror quota issues; final promotion will use promoted digest once mirror propagation completes."

liam: one operational caveat: pinning by digest means the chart version doesn't change; we should still increment `appVersion` in Chart.yaml? not necessary for rollback, but good for traceability.

deploy-bot: [info] Creating manual hold on promotion for session-service:v2026-04-02 due to degraded canary.

alex: I'll open PR with `values/canary-digest.yaml` and include the `image.digest` override and a note. Will run: `helm upgrade session-service ./chart -f values/canary-digest.yaml --reuse-values --wait --timeout 8m`

nora: also include a short rollback play: if pinned canary still fails after 12m, revert to previous stable release (session-service:v2026-03-28) and open a registry incident.

rachel: PR #2499 opened with the digest patch and release-note snippet. Starting the upgrade now. tagging @liam for review.

deploy-bot: [update] Upgrade started at 1769510030. 3/5 pods updated, 2/5 ready.

liam: verified PR changes; digest matches last-stable. Approve.

alex: pods coming up. no more 429s in pod events. good sign.

deploy-bot: [update] Canary healthy at 1769510085: readiness 100% (5/5). Manual hold remains until release lead unholds.

nora: Recommend leaving hold for 30m to allow mirror propagation and metrics to settle. Add note to changelog explaining temporary pin and the rollback criteria.

alex: leaving manual hold and adding the changelog note now. Will also add ops playbook entry for mirror-429 during rotations.

deploy-bot: [auto] Manual hold applied by alex at 1769510102. Promotion will resume per release lead when unheld.
